## Trial periods

- [[source-braintree-recurring-article-trial-periods]] - article-level route for delaying the first billing date without consuming billing cycles, while requiring a payment method at subscription start and automatically charging the day after the trial ends. Preserve its warning that customers are not notified by default and that missing notice or opt-out can create negative-option and chargeback risk; exact timing and notice guidance remain in the raw locator.
warnings: Do not imply that trial duration counts toward the configured billing-cycle total; the article says it does not.
Preserve the timing qualification that the automatic charge occurs the day after the trial period ends.
Do not imply that Braintree alerts customers by default; the article assigns proactive notice to the merchant and warns about opt-out, negative-option billing and chargeback risk.
Keep this article route distinct from Node.js recurring-billing guides and dedicated Plan or Subscription API references.
